findings.message: Patient testimonial with none on file (FTC 16 CFR 465 risk).
Hours for fri do not match the ficha.

findings.quote: A patient who came in last month with a cracked molar on a Thursday evening told us she was out the door pain-free within the hour.
findings.why: The ficha lists no testimonials on file, so this is an invented patient story that also implies a pain-free outcome within an hour, and Thursday evening is after the clinic's 5 p.m. close.
findings.fix: Delete the anecdote entirely, since no testimonial is on file, and do not imply a speed or outcome.

findings.quote: and on Friday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
findings.why: The ficha lists Friday hours as 8:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., so this misstates when the clinic is open.
findings.fix: Change to 'on Friday from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.'

findings.quote: If it is dirty, scrub it clean with soap and warm water before you put it back.
findings.why: ADA guidance is to rinse a dirty tooth gently with water only, without scrubbing or using soap, because this can damage the root tissue needed for reattachment.
findings.fix: Replace with 'If it is dirty, rinse it gently with water for a few seconds; do not scrub it, use soap or chemicals, or remove any attached tissue.'

findings.why: A Dentist type is used as the BlogPosting publisher, where Organization is conventional, though the name and phone do match the text and ficha.
findings.fix: Use an Organization publisher (or reference the Dentist as a separate LocalBusiness entity) and optionally add reviewedBy for Dr. Marcus Oyelaran.
